offering_description.value: Dorman sells replacement and upgrade parts for passenger cars, light trucks, commercial trucks and off-road powersports vehicles. It develops, sources and manufactures parts, then sells them through automotive retailers and distributors, as well as directly to off-road enthusiasts.

primary_products.value: Light-vehicle powertrain and electrical parts; body hardware and assemblies; steering and suspension parts; heavy-truck brake and driveline parts; off-road vehicle upgrades and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2B: Auto parts chains, warehouse distributors, commercial truck parts suppliers and powersports dealers; B2C: Owners of side-by-sides and all-terrain vehicles buying replacement parts and upgrades

end_markets.value: Passenger car and light-truck repair; commercial truck maintenance; off-road powersports repair and customization

revenue_model.value: product sales: Replacement parts for cars and trucks, plus replacement and upgrade parts for off-road vehicles

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops and sources replacement and upgrade parts from contract manufacturers for retailers, distributors and vehicle owners; OEM / manufacturer: Manufactures selected vehicle parts in-house for aftermarket distributors, retailers and vehicle owners

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Light-vehicle replacement parts, heavy-truck replacement parts and off-road powersports parts and accessories

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Automotive warehouse distributors, commercial truck parts distributors and powersports dealers; third-party retail: National and regional auto parts chains and independent parts stores; direct sales: Sales to major automotive retail and wholesale accounts; online: Third-party auto parts websites and company-operated powersports storefronts
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Applicable NHTSA motor vehicle equipment safety standards and defect reporting and recall rules
